page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s3 server family. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 4 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core. The CPU allocation is dedicated, ensuring consistent processing capabilities without resource contention from neighboring tenants.

The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 1.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring users to attach external block storage for operating system and application data. Additionally, no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this configuration.

Given the 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to memory, this instance is suited for compute-focused workloads that require dedicated CPU execution but have minimal memory footprints. Typical deployment scenarios include lightweight web servers, distributed compute nodes, batch processing tasks, and basic utility services that do not demand extensive RAM or local disk caching.
